title: Implement KP Article V1 RC1 through the economics exemplar
summary: Execute the approved 24-slice authoring, compiler, development-toolbar, editor, and economics migration plan through the required human checkpoint.
expectedLearning: Whether four closed Markdown directives can replace three writable economics representations without source noise or learner-visible drift.
Whether one framework-neutral article IR can drive static, interactive, deck, navigation, accessibility, and editor projections.
Whether a universal development toolbar can preserve route state while remaining absent from production.
allowedWork: RC1 parser, validator, source maps, import lock, IR, static compilation, accessibility, stage manifests, deck derivation, CodeMirror language tooling and persistence, development toolbar, and economics migration.
disallowedWork: Layout, graph style, salience, choreography, arbitrary executable article code, another lesson migration, Public Web, Public Editor, SvelteKit, Canvas, WebGL, Graph3D, or animation-promotion work.
